title: VESPER NodeCapabilityProfile
description: IC-004. Hardware agnosticism is asserted in three documents and implemented by none unless this exists. Two axes are deliberately SEPARATE: trust_zone (may this node be relied on?) and availability_class (how reliably is it awake?). Conflating them is why the iPhone was previously excluded from continuity altogether -- it is trustworthy but not continuously available, which are different problems with different answers. Authority: SR-015, SR-019, SR-050, SR-057, SR-058, SR-060, DR-008, DR-024; REM-011, REM-014.

memory_architecture.description: SR-057 binds to this, not to a product name (INV-HW-1).

sustained_tokens_per_sec.description: MEASURED at enrollment, per model class -- never declared (INV-HW-2). A node with no measured value is never routed to; CI-034 rejects any code path that sets this from configuration.

security_baseline.description: Determines trust_zone at admission. 'Visibility on a LAN does not imply trust'; this is what does.

trust_zone.description: Z0 core trusted (may hold state, issue commands, receive secrets) | Z1 controlled worker | Z2 limited trust (may render and observe ONLY -- INV-TRUST-1) | Z3 external.

availability_class.description: SR-058. Orthogonal to trust_zone. A foreground_only node may be fully trusted (Z0) and still unsuitable as the SOLE holder of a continuity-critical capability (INV-TRUST-2) -- but it is a valid LAST-RESORT survival host (SR-060, INV-PLACE-3).

survival_capable.description: SR-060: may this node host the survival profile when it is the only node reachable? Requires Z0 or Z1 trust and durable local storage. A node with survival_capable=false cannot keep VESPER alive alone.

roles.description: control_candidate requires trust_zone Z0 AND availability_class in {always_on, usually_on}.

allOf.$comment: INV-TRUST-1 -- Z2 may render and observe only.
A control plane cannot live on a node that is not reliably awake.
INV-HW-2 -- a measured profile carries its measurement time.
